Projects.Name: AWS.Speech.MEAI
ChangelogMessages: Added the initial AWS.Speech.MEAI package scaffold. Microsoft.Extensions.AI speech clients over Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Polly, plus a VoiceAgent that composes speech-to-text, an IChatClient, and text-to-speech into a full-duplex voice loop, land in subsequent PRs of the stack.

Projects.Name: AWS.Bedrock.MEAI
ChangelogMessages: Updated the AWSSDK.BedrockRuntime dependency to 4.0.101.1 to align AWSSDK.Core with the Amazon Transcribe and Amazon Polly SDKs used by AWS.Speech.MEAI.

Projects.Name: AWS.AgentCore.Hosting
ChangelogMessages: Updated the direct AWSSDK.BedrockRuntime dependency to 4.0.101.1 to match the version now required transitively through AWS.Bedrock.MEAI.
